english: I eat sushi.
hint: Topic は → object を → verb (ます) last.
notes: SOV: 私は (topic) 寿司を (object) 食べます.

english: This is a book.
hint: X は Y です — topic + noun + です.
notes: これ/それ/あれ take は for identification.

english: Tanaka goes to school.
hint: Destination: に (or へ) before motion verbs like 行きます.
notes: 学校に行きます or 学校へ行きます — both destination particles are fine. Unused に/へ stays in the pool.

english: I study Japanese at the library.
hint: Place of action uses で (not に). Object を before the verb.
notes: で = where the action happens; に = destination/existence.

english: There is a cat on the chair.
hint: Location に + が + います/あります for existence.
notes: Nounの上に — の links the position noun. Living things use います.

english: I drink coffee every morning.
hint: Time words often come first (no particle needed for 毎朝).
notes: Frequency/time adverbs like 毎朝 usually need no particle.

english: Yuki is a student.
hint: Name は + noun です.
notes: Simple copular sentence: A は B です.

english: I bought bread at the store.
hint: Past ます → ました. Place of shopping: で.
notes: 買う → 買いました. Object still marked with を.

english: Please give me water.
hint: Noun を ください — polite request.
notes: ください follows the object particle を.

english: I go to Tokyo by train.
hint: Means of transport: で. Destination: に.
notes: で marks how (by train); に marks where you're going.

english: The weather is good today.
hint: 今日は sets the topic; が marks what is good.
notes: い-adjective + です for polite form.

english: I meet a friend at the station.
hint: 会う takes に for the person you meet; place of meeting: で.
notes: 友達に会う — the person met is marked with に, not を.

english: My older sister also likes music.
hint: も replaces は ("also"). 好き takes が for the liked thing.
notes: 好き／嫌い mark the object of feeling with が.

english: From nine until five I work.
hint: から = from; まで = until. Time range before the verb.
notes: AからBまで — classic span pattern.

english: I read the newspaper every day.
hint: 毎日 is the time. Object を, verb (ます) last.
notes: 私は毎日新聞を読みます. を marks what you read.

english: This is my bag.
hint: X は Y です. の links owner and thing.
notes: 私のかばん — の between two nouns.

english: The library is quiet.
hint: Place は na-adjective です.
notes: 静かです — な-adjective plus です. は is the topic, not に.

english: I get up at seven.
hint: Clock time takes に. Verb last.
notes: 七時に起きます. に marks a specific time.

english: There is a dog in the park.
hint: Place に, thing が, います for a living thing.
notes: 公園に犬がいます. あります would be for an object, not an animal.

english: She goes home by bus.
hint: で marks the means. に would mark a destination.
notes: バスで帰ります — vehicle で.

english: I write a letter to a friend.
hint: Recipient に, object を, verb last.
notes: 友達に手紙を書きます. に is the person who receives it.

english: My father is a doctor.
hint: X は Y です.
notes: 父は医者です. は presents the topic.

english: I don't eat meat.
hint: ます-negative is ません. Object still takes を.
notes: 肉を食べません.

english: The bank is next to the station.
hint: X は Y の隣です.
notes: 駅の隣 — の between the reference point and 隣.

english: Please wait a moment.
hint: て-form + ください is a polite request.
notes: ちょっと待ってください.

english: I watch a movie on Sunday.
hint: A day of the week takes に. Object を.
notes: 日曜日に映画を見ます.

english: The water is cold.
hint: 冷たい is cold to the touch. 寒い is cold weather.
notes: 水は冷たいです.

english: My house is in Osaka.
hint: Existence of a thing: place に, あります.
notes: 家は大阪にあります. に is the location, not で.

english: How much is this?
hint: いくら asks the price. か makes it a question.
notes: これはいくらですか.

english: I like fish.
hint: 好き takes が, not を.
notes: 魚が好きです. を is the usual mistake.

english: There are children in the classroom.
hint: Place に, living subject が, います.
notes: 教室に子供がいます.

english: I buy vegetables at the supermarket.
hint: Place of the action is で. Object is を.
notes: スーパーで野菜を買います. に would mark a destination, not the shop where you buy.

english: I will go to the museum tomorrow.
hint: Destination に. Relative days like 明日 take no particle.
notes: 明日博物館に行きます.

english: He is good at Japanese.
hint: 上手 takes が, like 好き.
notes: 日本語が上手です. 下手 is the opposite.

english: I listen to music at night.
hint: 夜に is the time. を marks what you listen to.
notes: 夜に音楽を聞きます.

english: My younger brother is ten years old.
hint: Age is noun + です. 歳 is the counter.
notes: 弟は十歳です.

english: Please open the window.
hint: て-form + ください. Object を.
notes: 窓を開けてください. 閉めて is the opposite.

english: I come to school at eight-thirty.
hint: Time に and place に. Either order is accepted.
notes: 八時半に学校に来ます, or 学校に八時半に来ます. Both に tiles are the same particle.

english: There is a book on the desk.
hint: Location に, thing が, あります for an object.
notes: 机の上に本があります.

english: I go home with a friend.
hint: と means 'together with'. に is the destination.
notes: 友達とうちに帰ります.

english: I will call you when I arrive at the airport.
hint: 〜たら = when/if (after doing). Clause first, then main action.
notes: 着いたら — conditional/temporal たら before the main clause.

english: I woke up early and took a walk.
hint: て-form links actions in sequence.
notes: 起きて + 散歩をしました — short て-chain.

english: Because it was cold, I wore a coat.
hint: Reason clause + から, then result.
notes: い-adj past 寒かった + から for "because".

english: The book I bought yesterday was interesting.
hint: Relative clause comes before the noun it modifies (買った本).
notes: No relative pronoun — just plain form + noun.

english: You may look at this photo.
hint: 〜てもいい = permission ("it's OK if you…").
notes: て-form + もいいです for polite permission.

english: I must do homework tonight.
hint: 〜なければなりません = must / have to.
notes: Negative ば + なりません expresses obligation.

english: I became able to speak a little Japanese.
hint: Potential 話せる + ようになりました = became able to.
notes: Ability/change: が + potential + ようになる.

english: Please don't forget your ticket.
hint: ないでください = please don't…
notes: Negative て-form (ないで) + ください.

english: Compared to last year, it's hotter this year.
hint: Aより Bの方が — comparative pattern.
notes: より marks the baseline; の方が the thing that's more ~.

english: I'm thinking of going to Kyoto next month.
hint: Volitional 行こう + と思っています = planning/thinking of.
notes: Quote particle と before 思う／思っている.

english: While listening to music, I cook.
hint: 〜ながら = while doing (same subject, secondary action first).
notes: ながら clause states the background action.

english: I want to eat ramen.
hint: たい attaches to the masu-stem. The thing you want takes が.
notes: ラーメンが食べたいです. を is the common mistake.

english: I have been to Kyoto.
hint: たことがある = have the experience of.
notes: 京都に行ったことがあります. 行った is いった, not おこなった.

english: After work ends, I drink tea.
hint: てから = after doing that, then the next action.
notes: 終わってから. から here is part of てから, not the reason から.

english: I am reading a book now.
hint: ている = an action in progress.
notes: 今本を読んでいます.

english: Please try this cake.
hint: てみる = try doing it and see.
notes: 食べてみてください.

english: You must not run here.
hint: てはいけない = it is not allowed.
notes: ここで走ってはいけません. で is the place of the action.

english: I will buy the ticket ahead of time.
hint: ておく = do it in advance.
notes: 切符を買っておきます.

english: This camera is too expensive.
hint: すぎる attaches to the adjective stem.
notes: 高すぎます — stem 高 plus すぎます.

english: This dictionary is easy to use.
hint: ます-stem + やすい = easy to do.
notes: 使いやすいです.

english: I plan to study abroad next year.
hint: dictionary form + つもりです = the speaker's plan.
notes: 来年留学するつもりです.

english: It looks like it will rain tomorrow.
hint: ます-stem + そうです = it looks like it will.
notes: 雨が降りそうです. Based on what you see now.

english: I heard that shop is closed.
hint: Noun + だそうです = hearsay.
notes: 休みだそうです. You did not see it yourself.

english: You don't have to come tomorrow.
hint: なくてもいい = it is not necessary.
notes: 来なくてもいいです. 来る negative is こない, so こなくても.

english: I wash my hands before eating.
hint: dictionary form + 前に = before doing that.
notes: 食べる前に. The main action comes after.

english: I had my older brother teach me Japanese.
hint: に + て-form + もらう = someone does it for me.
notes: 兄に教えてもらいました. あげる would point the favor the wrong way.

english: Shall we go as far as the station by taxi?
hint: ましょうか invites. まで is the limit, で is the means.
notes: 駅までタクシーで行きましょうか.

english: I have started learning the piano.
hint: ます-stem + 始める = begin to do.
notes: 習い始めました.

english: Please turn off the light before you leave.
hint: dictionary form + 前に, then てください.
notes: 出かける前に電気を消してください.

english: If you have time, please call.
hint: たら = if / when that happens.
notes: 時間があったら電話してください.

english: I gave my friend a present.
hint: にあげる = I give to someone else.
notes: 友達にプレゼントをあげました. もらう would mean I received it.

english: This kanji is hard to read.
hint: ます-stem + にくい = hard to do.
notes: 読みにくいです. やすい is the opposite.

english: I think she has already gone home.
hint: Plain form + と思います quotes your thought.
notes: もう帰ったと思います. と marks the thought.

english: Have you ever eaten natto?
hint: たことがあるか asks about experience.
notes: 納豆を食べたことがありますか.

english: He likes cooking.
hint: dictionary form + のが好き = likes doing it.
notes: 料理をするのが好きです.

english: It's raining, so I'll take an umbrella.
hint: ている for the weather now. から gives the reason.
notes: 降っているから傘を持っていきます. This item uses から, not ので.

english: I went and left my umbrella on the bus.
hint: てしまう = it happened and you didn't mean to.
notes: バスに傘を忘れてしまいました. に is where you left it.

english: I didn't know the way, so I asked a station employee.
hint: なかったので = because (past negative). Ask someone に.
notes: 道が分からなかったので駅員に聞きました.

english: I want you to look at this photo.
hint: てほしい = I want you to do it. たい would mean I want to do it myself.
notes: 見てほしいです.

english: While I was out, it rained.
hint: ている間に = during that time, something else happened.
notes: 出かけている間に雨が降りました.

english: Because the train was delayed, I was late for the meeting.
hint: ので = softer "because" (reason feels more objective than から).
notes: Plain past + ので. 会議に遅刻する — に marks the event you're late for.

english: This letter was written by my mother.
hint: Passive: topic は + agent によって + passive verb.
notes: 書かれる → 書かれました. によって for the agent in formal passive.

english: The teacher made the students clean the classroom.
hint: Causative: causee に + object を + 〜させる.
notes: させる/させます — person made to act takes に.

english: As soon as I got home, I took a bath.
hint: 辞書形 + と = whenever/as soon as (natural result).
notes: 着くとすぐ — と + すぐ for "as soon as".

english: Despite being busy, she came to help.
hint: のに = although / despite. てくれる = did for my benefit.
notes: Adjective plain + のに. Purpose 手伝いに来る.

english: Depending on the weather, the picnic may be canceled.
hint: によって = depending on. かもしれません = might.
notes: 中止になる + かもしれません for possibility.

english: I had my friend check the document.
hint: 〜てもらう = have someone do something for you (agent に).
notes: Favour received: person に + て + もらう.

english: Not only Japanese but also English is spoken here.
hint: Aだけでなく Bも — not only A but also B. Passive polite.
notes: 話されている — passive continuous for "is spoken".

english: I ended up staying until late because of work.
hint: のせいで = because of (negative nuance). ことになる = ended up.
notes: ことになる often means an outcome decided / that came about.

english: I left home early so that I wouldn't be late.
hint: ないように = so that something does not happen.
notes: 遅れないように早くうちを出ました.

english: I have just come to Japan.
hint: たばかり = the action is still recent.
notes: 日本に来たばかりです. 来た is きた.

english: It's not that I dislike vegetables.
hint: わけではない softens a denial: that's not the case.
notes: 嫌いなわけではありません. な-adjective takes な before わけ.

english: The window was opened by the wind.
hint: によって marks the agent of a passive.
notes: 風によって開けられました. 開ける → 開けられる.

english: The manager made the staff write a report.
hint: Causer は, person made to act に, object を, causative verb.
notes: 書かせました. 書く → 書かせる.

english: I was made to wait for an hour.
hint: Causative-passive: someone made me do it, to my cost.
notes: 待たされました. 待つ becomes 待たされる, not 待たさせられる, in ordinary speech.

english: I decided to move next spring.
hint: ことにする = the speaker decides.
notes: 引っ越すことにしました.

english: It was decided that the meeting will be held online.
hint: ことになる = decided from outside, not your own choice.
notes: 行うことになりました. Contrast with ことにする.

english: I make a point of walking every day.
hint: ようにする = make an effort to keep doing it.
notes: 歩くようにしています.

english: While I wasn't looking, the child started to run.
hint: うちに = during that window, before the situation changes.
notes: 見ていないうちに子供が走り出しました.

english: Thanks to my teacher, I passed the exam.
hint: おかげで = a cause you are grateful for.
notes: 先生のおかげで試験に合格しました. に marks the exam.

english: He must be at the office.
hint: に違いない = the speaker is convinced.
notes: 事務所にいるに違いない.

english: You ought to apologize soon.
hint: dictionary form + べきだ = duty, in the speaker's view.
notes: 早く謝るべきです.

english: Every time I see this photo, I remember the trip.
hint: dictionary form + たびに = whenever.
notes: 見るたびに思い出します. The two を tiles are interchangeable.

english: I tried to open the door, but it wouldn't open.
hint: Volitional + とする = attempt. が = but.
notes: 開けようとした (transitive) but 開きませんでした (intransitive).

english: Getting up early is hard for me.
hint: にとって = from that person's point of view.
notes: 私にとって早起きはつらいです.

english: I am opposed to that plan.
hint: に marks what the stance is aimed at. は adds contrast.
notes: その計画には反対です.

english: As a student, I don't have much money.
hint: として = in the role of. あまり + negative.
notes: 学生としてお金があまりありません.

english: He tends to be late.
hint: がち = tends to, often a habit you don't admire.
notes: 遅刻しがちです.

english: I can't very well refuse this request.
hint: わけにはいかない = circumstances won't allow it, even if you could.
notes: 断るわけにはいきません. Not the same as 断れません (ability).

english: The report is supposed to be handed in by Friday.
hint: ことになっている = an existing rule or arrangement.
notes: 金曜日までに出すことになっています. までに is the deadline.

english: The phone rang in the middle of the meal.
hint: 最中に = right in the middle of.
notes: 食事の最中に電話が鳴りました.

english: Even though I explained, I couldn't get them to understand.
hint: にもかかわらず = even so, a strong contrast.
notes: 説明したにもかかわらず分かってもらえませんでした.

english: From the fact that smoke was rising, I realized it was a fire.
hint: ことから = the basis of a conclusion.
notes: 煙が出ていることから火事だと分かりました.

english: I asked them to speak more slowly.
hint: dictionary form + ように頼む = ask someone to do it.
notes: もっとゆっくり話すように頼みました.

english: No wonder he can speak English: he had studied abroad.
hint: わけだ = the result follows naturally.
notes: 留学していたので英語が話せるわけです.

english: I can't help worrying about the exam results.
hint: てならない = a feeling too strong to hold back.
notes: 心配でなりません.

english: The match was canceled on account of the rain.
hint: のため = due to. になる = it became that.
notes: 雨のため試合は中止になりました.

english: Just when I was about to give up, a reply came.
hint: stem + かける = partway into the action. たところ = at that moment.
notes: 諦めかけたところ返事が来ました.

english: Whether we go depends on the budget.
hint: かどうか = whether. 次第 = it depends on.
notes: 行くかどうかは予算次第です.

english: This book is written for children.
hint: Passive 書かれている describes how the book is. 向け = aimed at.
notes: 子供向けに書かれています.
